learning_outcomes.text: Critically review the mechanical performance and applications of a range of engineering materials.
Gain comprehensive knowledge of the principles and mechanisms of the advanced materials.
Select materials to meet the performance requirements of a range of engineering applications.
Have knowledge of new materials design and developments.

syllabus_topics: Structure, properties and applications of engineering materials.
Advanced materials, mechanisms, functions and applications.
The selection and design of materials on the basis of performance requirements.
Life cycle analysis, degradation of materials related to environmental.
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — MEng (Hons) Mechanical Engineering (Level 7 / master-level modules)
